# The per-PR Copilot regression set (TCL-1046).
#
# Every scenario here measures TCLAUDE's code against the real Copilot CLI, so
# it can regress on any push. Scenarios that measure COPILOT's own behaviour
# live in the discovery lab instead (TCLAUDE_COPILOT_FIXTURE_LAB=1, run from
# .github/workflows/copilot-lab.yml) — a pinned third-party binary cannot
# change between two of our pushes, so re-proving it per-PR costs minutes and
# proves nothing.
#
# This file is BOTH the `-run` filter and the anti-skip gate in the
# copilot-smoke job, so the two cannot drift: a scenario that is renamed
# without being renamed here stops matching the filter, does not run, and then
# fails the gate. Adding a scenario means adding a line; moving one to the lab
# means deleting a line and switching its requireSmoke* call to requireLab*.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.

# Our spawner's real argv reaches a provider and pins the session id.
TestCopilotProductionSpawnerLaunches
# Our directory-trust seeder clears the modal that would otherwise freeze
# every unattended pane (TCL-973).
TestCopilotDirTrustProductionSeedingClearsTheModal
# Our hook installer's file actually fires from a real session.
TestCopilotHooksFireFromTheInstalledFile
# Our conv-store reads a real session-state database.
TestCopilotConvStoreReadsRealSessionState
# Caller-chosen --session-id is honoured and --resume continues it.
TestCopilotSessionEnrollmentAndResume
# Our `tclaude ask` capture: clean stdout, and an exact resume.
TestCopilotAskCaptureIsCleanOnStdout
TestCopilotAskResumesExactly
# Our retire path really closes a pane mid-turn (TCL-1001).
TestCopilotSoftExitCancelFirstExitsMidTurn
# The baseline both of the above rest on: a credential-free BYOK turn
# completes, and a tool call round-trips back as a second request.
TestCopilotCredentialFreeTextTurn
TestCopilotToolCallRoundTrip
